summary: Admit macOS shell resource executions into per-job Darwin custody slots

schema.detail: Retains the existing shell execution and Darwin custody v2 wire schemas.

rules.detail: Darwin shell lanes heavy, gate and eval bind respectively to one, three and one UID custody slots. Scheduling priority remains a separate class. Program lanes remain logical and PTY seats remain detached.

compatibility.detail: The helper supports five compiled-in slot identities. Upgrade helper, runtime and per-slot provisioning together; no detached fallback is allowed. Nested Darwin shell roots are refused.

downtime.detail: No automatic service restart or slot activation.

manual.detail: Provision all slot users, shared roots, inheritable caller ACLs and pinned sudo rules. Payload sources must be accessible to the admitted UID without widening home-directory ACLs. Run root acceptance before activation.

recovery.detail: Job workspaces are removed only after custody retirement. Cleanup failures are reported as workspace leftovers; uncertain UID retirement retains custody.
